description: Proxmox VE hosts: the Linux rules plus the Proxmox tools (qm, pct, pvesh, pvecm, pveceph, pvesm, pveum).

rules.hint: API tokens are created in the Proxmox web interface, never shown in the console.

rules.pattern: ^(?:(?:qm|pct) (?:list|status|config|pending|showcmd|cloudinit dump|df|listsnapshot)\b.*|pvesh (?:get|ls|usage)\b.*|pveversion\b.*|pvecm (?:status|nodes|qdevice status|expected --help)\b.*|pvesm (?:status|list|path)\b.*|pveceph (?:status|osd ls|pool ls|mon ls)\b.*|ha-manager (?:status|config)\b.*|pvesr (?:status|list)\b.*|pve-firewall (?:status|compile|localnet)\b.*|pvenode (?:config get|cert info|task list|task status)\b.*|pveam (?:list|available)\b.*|pveum (?:user list|group list|role list|acl list|pool list|realm list)\b.*|pvereport|pvesubscription get|pveperf\b.*)$
